title_formula.name: The Impossible Paradox Formula
title_formula.equation: Title = [What seems impossible] + [The real physical constraint nobody explains] + [The scale that makes it terrifying]
title_formula.neuromarketing_principle: The Zeigarnik Effect: the brain cannot close an open logical contradiction. An impossible statement forces the click because the hippocampus needs to resolve the incongruence.

implied_threat.description: The title makes the viewer feel THEY are in personal danger, even if they are not.
examples: The Pipe Under Your Street That Could Explode at 600°C Right Now
Every Bridge You Cross Has This 3mm Flaw
implied_threat.neural_mechanism: Reticular Activating System (RAS) prioritises any information that implies personal danger above all other stimuli.

forbidden_number.description: Include a hyper-precise irregular number to signal access to classified technical data.
forbidden_number.neural_mechanism: Broken, irregular numbers (not round) activate unconscious credibility. The brain assumes precision = insider knowledge.

temporal_guillotine.description: Compress the catastrophe into a time fraction the brain cannot consciously process.
temporal_guillotine.neural_mechanism: The prefrontal cortex fails to calculate risk at sub-second time scales, generating cognitive anxiety that resolves only by clicking.

scale_inversion.description: The tiny object controls the giant system.
examples: The $12 Sensor That Keeps a $4 Billion Dam From Collapsing
The 3mm Wire That Powers 50 Million Homes
scale_inversion.neural_mechanism: Attacks the proportionality bias: the brain rejects that something small controls something enormous, and must resolve it.

invisible_paradox.description: The system is real, operates 24 hours, but nobody can see it.
examples: There's a 200-Bar Shockwave Inside Every Dam and You've Never Heard It
The Underground River of Jet Fuel Running Beneath Every Airport

brand_palette.primary_hud: #00E5FF (Cyan) — for technical data lines and HUD overlay
brand_palette.alert_focal: #FFE500 (Acid Yellow) or #FF3333 (Danger Red) — for the focal number
brand_palette.text: Pure white, brutalista/monospace bold, MAX 2-3 words

three_component_framework.component_1_hero_object: One industrial macro object in 4K occupying 60% of the frame — the physical cause of the failure (valve, cable, sensor, flame, shockwave). Dark background, all other elements de-emphasised.
three_component_framework.component_2_shock_text: 2-3 words MAX in brutalista white type. Examples: 'NEVER STOPS', 'SPLIT IN HALF', 'BURNING NOW', '0.02 SECONDS'. NEVER repeat words from the title.
three_component_framework.component_3_lethal_datum: The hyper-precise number in #FFE500 monospace — temperature, pressure, speed, cost. Examples: '1,200 m/s', '0.003s', '$12 SENSOR', '200 BAR'.

neuroscience_rules: Von Restorff Effect: Only 1 central object dominates 60% of the area. Everything else is dark. The eye has no choice but to land on that point.
Weber's Law: The focal point must have 4x more luminance than the background. The retina biologically prioritises luminosity deltas above 3:1.
Vectorial Directionality: HUD cyan lines radiating diagonally from the Hero Object create implicit movement — the thumbnail breathes, something is about to happen.
Alarm Colour on Datum: The key number always in #FFE500 or #FF3333. Never in white. Yellow/red activates the amygdala before conscious reading.
PROHIBITED: Faces, emojis, generic arrows, coloured borders, text over 3 words, anything that looks 'YouTuber' instead of 'industrial documentary'.

hypnotic_opening_15s_rule.formula: IMPOSSIBLE DATUM → VISCERAL CONSEQUENCE → HIDDEN MECHANISM REVEAL
hypnotic_opening_15s_rule.rule: Zero greetings. Zero introductions. Zero filler. Fire the 3 primitive instincts in the first 15 seconds: Avoid Danger, Conserve Energy, Discover Hidden Patterns.

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Presupposition Loading
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: The sentence assumes the viewer has already accepted the premise before processing it.
examples: What most engineers don't realize is...
The part nobody talks about is...

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Analog Marking
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: In narration, key words receive a 0.6s pause before and after + 2dB drop in tone. Creates neural anchors that fix information in working memory.
examples: In exactly... [0.6s pause]... three hundredths of a second.

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: The Double Bind
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: Offer the viewer two options that both lead to continued watching.
examples: You can either believe the dam is safe... or wait to see what happened at 02:47 AM.
Whether the engineers knew or not... the result was the same.

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Nested Loops
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: Open 3 simultaneous stories without closing any. Close in reverse order for maximum narrative satisfaction.
structure: Loop 1 (0s): Open with 2019 incident inciting event
Loop 2 (40s): Engineer who noticed problem 6 months prior
Loop 3 (1:20): Design flaw from 1974 that was never corrected

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Temporal Distortion
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: Alternate slow narration (sensory details, ambient sound, slow-motion) with fast narration (data bursts, rapid cuts). Viewer loses track of time elapsed. 12-minute videos feel like 5.
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.cadence: Slow 30s block → Fast 20s block → Slow 25s block → Fast 15s block → repeat

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Amnesia by Interruption
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: At the moment a technical explanation reaches peak complexity, interrupt with an abrupt visual cut + sub-bass spike (80Hz, 0.3s). Brain resets the attention cycle — fires every 45-60 seconds.

eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.name: Yes-Set Momentum
eriksonian_hypnosis_retention_laws.description: Before presenting the most absurd datum, make 3 statements the viewer automatically agrees with. The brain is primed to accept the 4th.
example: The larger the pipe, the more pressure it holds. (Yes)
This pipe holds 200 bar — enough to cut through a steel plate at 40 meters. (Accepted before processed)

2_srt_semantic_metadata_seeding.name: Semantic SRT Seeding
2_srt_semantic_metadata_seeding.rule: YouTube's algorithm (Gemini NLP) reads 100% of video transcriptions to classify the video semantically and decide which suggested bar it appears in. Control this classification by planting high-density semantic terms belonging to the cluster of giant competitor channels.
execution: Write keywords naturally into the narration script.
Upload a manual .srt subtitle file (not auto-generated) containing 100% of these terms, correctly spelled, no abbreviations.
YouTube cross-references the transcript with the semantic graph of existing channels and inserts the video into their sidebar.

3_session_hijacking_end_screen.name: Single-Item End Screen Session Hijack
3_session_hijacking_end_screen.rule: Never use 2 elements on the end screen. Use ONLY 1: the next strongest video in the catalogue (the current outlier). The algorithm uses 'Viewers Who Watched Another Video' as the highest-weighted metric for suggested placement in 2026.

inviolable_filters_before_briefing.question: Does the title contain a physical paradox or impossible constraint that creates a Zeigarnik open loop?
Does the title or thumbnail contain a hyper-precise irregular number (not round) that implies insider/classified knowledge?
Can the physical cause of the anomaly be isolated in ONE macro industrial 4K object in the thumbnail?
Is the script opening (first 15 seconds) written as: IMPOSSIBLE DATUM → VISCERAL CONSEQUENCE → HIDDEN MECHANISM REVEAL with zero greetings or filler?
Is there a 45-second hard-cut Short bridge with a cliffhanger pointing (via Related Video) to the long master?
Does the script contain naturally embedded SRT seeding keywords for Wendover / Real Engineering / Practical Engineering clusters?
Is the title completely free of descriptive/academic structure ('How X works', 'Why X happens', 'What is X')?
inviolable_filters_before_briefing.note: Exception: only if combined with a Forbidden Number or Impossible Paradox that overrides the academic framing.
